description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based embedded application demonstrating filesystem operations with littlefs, including directory listing, file modification, and mounting/unmounting procedures.

methods.name: lsdir
methods.description: Lists directory contents at the specified path, logging directories and files.

methods.name: littlefs_increase_infile_value
methods.description: Reads, increments, and writes back a counter value in a file.

methods.name: incr_pattern
methods.description: Modifies a pattern buffer by incrementing values.

methods.name: init_pattern
methods.description: Initializes a pattern buffer with a specific pattern.

methods.name: print_pattern
methods.description: Prints the pattern buffer in hex format.

methods.name: littlefs_binary_file_adj
methods.description: Adjusts a binary file by reading, modifying, and rewriting its pattern.

methods.name: littlefs_flash_erase
methods.description: Erases a flash area if configured.

methods.name: littlefs_mount
methods.description: Mounts the littlefs filesystem, optionally erasing flash beforehand.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing filesystem mount, directory listing, file modification, and unmount.
